scenario.topic: Decide between remote and in-person attendance for a professional conference

options.name: Attend Fully In-Person
options.upside: Direct face-to-face networking and full access to all sessions.
options.concern: Travel time and expenses increase overall cost and time commitment.

options.name: Attend Fully Remote
options.upside: No travel needed and lower registration cost.
options.concern: Limited informal networking and potential for technical issues.

options.name: Attend In-Person Only for Workshops
options.upside: Hands-on workshop participation with some travel and cost savings.
options.concern: Misses some keynote sessions available only remotely or in-person fully.

options.name: Attend Remote with Optional In-Person Networking Event
options.upside: Flexible attendance with remote session access and some in-person networking.
options.concern: Additional travel for networking event may reduce convenience.

shared_context: Two professionals must decide how to attend an upcoming three-day conference with networking sessions and workshops. Both remote and in-person attendance options are available, each with different costs, travel requirements, and interaction levels.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a mid-level project manager who values hands-on learning and cost efficiency.
personas.private_goal: Maximize workshop engagement while minimizing overall travel and expenses.

A.reason_for: Offers full access and high networking opportunities.
A.reason_against: Travel time and higher cost make it less appealing.

B.reason_for: No travel and lower registration fee reduce costs.
B.reason_against: Limited networking and less immersive experience.

C.reason_for: Provides hands-on workshops with moderate networking and cost savings.

D.reason_for: Flexible attendance with some in-person networking.
D.reason_against: Additional travel for networking event may reduce convenience.
